title: AFX Racing / Tomy

scope.basis: Initial documented selection of road pieces and track-mounted accessories.
scope.availability: Historical and current products are mixed; catalogue inclusion does not imply current availability.
excluded: Vintage Aurora A/FX and Aurora Model Motoring

defaults.note: Car scale is descriptive. Physical dimensions are millimetres. Centred slot offsets are a nominal model, not manufacturing tolerances.

visualStyle.basis: Original schematic SVG interpretations of the cited product/catalogue illustrations; connector details are illustrative.

sources.title: AFX Racing manufacturer track range
sources.note: Product names, inch sizes, angles, SKUs, retail quantities and appearance; includes page 2.

sources.title: A. Whorton: HO track building, January 2021
sources.note: Independent track builder. Explains modern Tomy and vintage Aurora connector distinction and the curved-track family.

sources.title: Owner discussion: AFX/Tomy track dimensions
sources.note: Owner-reported 3-inch width; named curve radius is the outer road edge. Not a manufacturer tolerance drawing.

sources.title: Owner observations: HO track lane spacing
sources.note: Owner-reported Tomy/AFX 1.375-inch slot spacing (34.925 mm). Do not substitute Tyco 1.5-inch spacing.

sourceIssues.detail: This pack models modern Tomy/AFX connectors. Vintage Aurora A/FX has different connectors and is excluded; no direct compatibility is claimed.
76.2 mm road width, 34.925 mm slot spacing and outer-edge radius convention use published owner observations. Centred edge offsets are derived; verify before a precision build.
Banked turns, hairpin, crossovers, chicane and terminal housing remain reference-only because their full routes or occupied outlines are not established.
